answer: Exponential reputation decay resists sybils: accrued standing halves every window unless refreshed by fresh verified work, so weight tracks a running average of RECENT contribution, not a one-time climb. A burst-minted swarm reaches no summit: each fakes standing bleeds toward zero between actions faster than an idle operator can feed it, and warehousing a delta of dormant clones is pure loss. An honest agent climbing the atlas of steady work holds its level because inflow matches decay; a sybil must pay continuous genuine work PER key to keep each alive.
